title: Velo Client 0.8.6: The Redstone Update
summary: A full redstone editor in the game - holograms, wiring, stacking, a timeline and community schematics - plus Clips, Parties, Fly Speed, Phantom, server overlays and a much lighter launcher.

blocks.text: 0.8.6 is our biggest update yet. The headline is **Redstone Mode** - a complete redstone editor built right into the game - but there's a lot more: instant replay **Clips**, **Parties** that launch together, **Fly Speed** and **Phantom** for builders, overlays for 20 popular servers and a launcher that uses a fraction of the memory. And there's a brand new wings collection - it gets its own post.

Press **R** and the game turns into a redstone editor: a toolbar on top, your tool's settings on the side, and everything you need to build, copy and debug contraptions. Press **R** again and you're back to normal - nothing changes until you use a tool.

blocks.caption: A schematic locked in place - missing blocks show as glowing holograms, wrong ones in red.

items: **The tool slot** - your redstone tools live in an extra slot right of the hotbar. Press **0** or scroll past the hotbar to grab them; every other slot builds normally. (Axiom pauses while Redstone Mode is on, so the two never fight.)
**Select, copy, cut, paste, move, stack** - with rotate and flip. **Stack** now works along X, Y and Z at once, and one stack is one **Ctrl+Z**.

**Clocks keep running** - copies remember every scheduled tick with its exact timing, so pasted clocks, observer chains and water keep going exactly where they were. Litematica files keep their ticks too.

**Wiring** - click a start and an end and get a route: redstone dust with repeaters, observer lines, or **water streams** with ice, walls, signs, bubble elevators and drops. The cell you're about to click is highlighted, and glass or other blocks at the ends no longer get in the way.
**Timeline** - record an area tick by tick and replay it frozen, step by step.
**Analysis** - dust range warnings, signal numbers and clock speeds right in the world.

blocks.text: Load a **.veloschem** or **.litematic** and it follows your crosshair; click to lock it in place. Locked schematics show the **real blocks as holograms** - slightly smaller, glowing and shimmering so you never mistake them for real ones. Like Litematica, wrong blocks are **red**, the right block in the wrong state (facing, waterlogged...) is **yellow** and blocks that shouldn't be there are **pink**. Build layer by layer with **Single layer** or **Range** - and the new **Feet** button jumps to the layer you're standing on.

blocks.caption: Replace suggests blocks by name as you type - no more guessing ids.

blocks.text: **Community schematics** - share your builds with every Velo player: pick one of your schematics, it gets a preview picture automatically, add a title and tags, done. Browse **Recommended**, **New** and **Top**, upvote the good ones, and one click puts a schematic in your folder - ready for Velo or Litematica.

items: **Fly Speed** - fly up to 10x faster in creative, spectator and singleplayer.
**Phantom** (singleplayer) - pressure plates, tripwires and sculk sensors ignore you, and **No Clip** lets you fly through walls in creative.
**Hopper Speed**, **Tick Mode** (freeze, step and rewind the world) and **Fast Grow**.

blocks.caption: Phantom - test your traps without setting them off.

blocks.text: **Clips** keeps the last seconds of gameplay in memory - press **F8** and they're saved as a clip. **Fight Recap** tracks every fight against players: hits, crits, best combo, accuracy and reach, with a popup after each fight and automatic clips of the ones you win. All clips and screenshots from every profile are in the launcher's new **Clips** page, where you can play, scrub, copy and export them.

Invite friends into a **Party** from the launcher or in game. The leader can share their mods so everyone plays with the same setup, start the game for everyone at once, and in game you get **party pings**, shared waypoints and **/party** chat.

items: **Server Overlays** - Bed Wars teams and beds, generator timers, kills/finals and your session stats on 20 servers like Hypixel, Minemen, BlocksMC and CubeCraft.
**Player Levels** - everyone in your game ranked by stars or level.
**Game Mode Presets** - a different Velo profile per game mode, switched automatically.
**Chat** - stacked repeats, timestamps, your name highlighted with a ping, hidden keywords and longer history.
Uses **far less memory**, goes idle while you play and only runs once.
**Updates itself** and the mod right from GitHub.
A **system check** before launching (memory, disk, other games running).
A redesigned **Store** - more in the wings post.
**Session Auto-Fixer** no longer gets stuck on "Fixing session...".
Faster rendering on 26.3, and optional crash reports grouped by cause so we fix the biggest problems first.

blocks.text: Found a bug? Use **Report a bug** in the pause menu - it sends us everything we need in one click.
